content:
asha: Thinking out loud — instead of one-size-fits-all auto-rollback, what if we introduce "safety templates" that encode degradation-routing strategies per risk class? idea: map customer/route -> template, templates drive rollback vs degrade vs divert actions. looking for design feedback on templates + runtime hooks.

ben: Love the idea. Can you give an example template?

asha: Sure, rough draft: 
```yaml
template: low-risk-default
actions:
  - type: PAUSE_ROLLOUT
    trigger: score >= 0.6
    cooldown: 5m
  - type: DEGRADE_TO_SMALLER_MODEL
    trigger: latency_p99 > 1200ms AND error_rate < 0.02
    max_traffic: 20%
  - type: DIVERT_TO_CACHE
    trigger: hallucination_rate > 0.01
    max_ttl: 60s
observability:
  store_snapshots_for: 14d
  replayable: true
  audit_log_prefix: s3://redwood-audit/safety-templates/
```

vika: Nice. Degrade->smaller-model is important to reduce cost/latency without full rollback. A few questions: 1) how do we guarantee semantic compatibility when switching to a smaller model? 2) how do we validate the template before enabling?

asha: 1) runtime must support variant compatibility metadata: model_capabilities hash (tokens, functions, tool-calls permitted). templates can include capability constraints and a validation step rejects incompatible actions. 2) templates are versioned and staged: dry-run in staging (shadow traffic) -> canary templates -> promoted. We need a template-linting job that runs a deterministic sim.

ben: Thinking about policy scope: per-route, per-tenant, per-organization. Also want overrides at the owner level. We should have an evaluation precedence: route-level override > tenant-level template > org-level default.

asha: Agree. Also we must keep an immutable verdict stream for audit and replay. every decision event should include input snapshot hash, template_version, model_hash, route_id, and the exact action chosen.

ops-bot: [monitor] safety-template-replay-failures > 0 in staging at 2026-03-16T09:02Z :warning:

vika: Replay is critical. Suggest storing both raw telemetry window and a compact trace so we can reproduce the exact decision: e.g., {window_start, window_end, samples[], aggregated_metrics}. Then the sim runner can feed the adjudicator and runtime in a sandbox.

ben: On the runtime hooks: we minimize endpoints. Runtime should accept: POST /v2/rollouts/{id}/snapshot (one-shot), GET /v2/rollouts/{id}/verdicts (immutable list), and POST /v2/rollouts/{id}/apply-action which returns async operation id. runtime picks up operation id and returns when action applied or aborted.

asha: Also add a 'degradation-router' interface: allows runtime to request a target variant for degraded traffic. e.g., POST /v2/rollouts/{id}/degrade -> {target_variant: small-llm-v2, rate: 0.2, ttl_secs: 300}. runtime enforces traffic split and reports metrics back.

vika: Failure modes: split-brain between template engine and runtime (stale templates), and multi-region discrepancy where one region degrades while another continues. we need strong template TTL and template-change monotonic versions. runtime should reject templates older than active_version.

ben: Multi-region: template evaluation should be region-aware. snapshots must include region tag. adjudicator can produce region-scoped actions (apply in region-a only) or global actions. templates can specify "scope: regional|global|route-only".

asha: Observability and SLOs: propose events and metrics: 
- safety.template.evaluations.total (labels: template, outcome)
- safety.template.degradations.applied (labels: template, target_variant)
- safety.rollbacks.automated.count
- safety.decision.latency.p95
- safety.undecided.rate
plus histogram of decision_confidence.

ops-bot: [deploy-bot] safety-templates v0.2 deployed to canary at 2026-03-16T09:15Z :rocket:

vika: We also need operator UX: timeline view showing snapshot -> decision -> actions applied -> revert history. And quick controls: "force-degrade", "force-rollback", "snooze-auto-actions". UI actions must produce signed audit events.

ben: Security: only ops role can modify org-level templates. Route owners can propose template variants but must go through promotion. all template mutations must be recorded in an append-only ledger (signed commits).

asha: Cost-awareness: templates can include cost budget constraints. E.g., if cost_delta > 0.15 and customer risk is "sensitive", prefer degrade over continue. also track cumulative cost_impact during a rollout window and cap auto-ops if budget exceeded.

vika: Edge-case: golden-prompt poisoning. If someone spikes golden prompt failures (false positives), we need to detect correlated signals across many prompts vs single-prompt anomaly. include clustering signal: golden_prompt_outliers_count.

ben: Replay API sketch: POST /v2/replay -> {snapshot_ids: [id1,id2], template_version: v2, mode: sim|apply}. Response: {replay_id, results: [{snapshot_id, verdict, simulated_actions}]}. Must be deterministic.

asha: Implementation notes:
- template engine is a lightweight stateless service that evaluates templates against snapshots and returns a scored action list.
- a "safety-orchestrator" owns sequencing and operator escalation. it listens to verdicts and coordinates apply_action calls to runtime, enforces leader election per rollout (consensus via Redis lease).
- runtime keeps last-known template_version and refuses to apply actions from older versions.

ops-bot: [monitor] safety-decision-confidence < 0.5 spike detected at 2026-03-16T09:40Z :warning:

vika: Operational playbook: default to "recommend-only" for new templates. require 48h observation window, then enable auto-apply for low-risk routes. provide kill-switch per-tenant.

ben: Testing: unit tests for template-linter, integration tests with fake runtime and metric streams, end-to-end chaos run where adjudicator drops out and runtime must fallback to baseline.

asha: Action items: 1) i'll draft RFC for safety-templates + degrade-router API; 2) vika will prototype template-linter; 3) ben will mock runtime apply-action behavior for tests. sync Thursday 11am?

vika: Thursday 11am works. I'll add initial PR with linter rules.
